enrichment.summary: 3Ls The Academy, an Oakland group, will offer family literacy workshops on evenings or weekends, tutoring by trained and fingerprinted tutors, and literacy coaching for principals at six elementary schools. A data sharing agreement sets rules for protecting student data it receives. outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Extends no-cost Oakland Promise agreement for baby, college savings and scholarship programs to 2029
enrichment.summary: Oakland Promise will provide four programs to district students and families: Brilliant Baby for infants and parents, Kindergarten to College for grades K-5, College Access for middle and high schoolers, and College Completion scholarships and support for graduates. The end date moves from October 31, 2026 to October 31, 2029, at no cost to the district. It is listed as a ratification, meaning an after-the-fact approval, and closely matches item R.-110.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
